name: Couch Stretch
notes:
Target / Focus: Hip flexor relief, pelvic tilt alignment.
Duration: 2 min per side (4 min total).
Execution: Place knee against wall or couch, step front foot forward, squeeze rear glute tightly.

name: Taube / Pigeon Pose
notes:
Target / Focus: Stretch glutes & piriformis, relieve SI joint.
Duration: 1.5–2 min per side.
Execution: Front leg bent across body, back leg straight behind. Lean chest forward with control.

name: 90/90 Hüftrotation
notes:
Target / Focus: Internal & external hip mobility.
Duration: 1.5–2 min dynamic.
Execution: Sit on floor with both legs bent at 90 degrees. Rotate smoothly side to side.

name: Triggerpunkt-Behandlung (Gluteus & Piriformis)
notes:
Target / Focus: Release myofascial trigger points in glutes.
Duration: 2–3 min.
Execution: Sit on lacrosse ball on glute, find tender spots, hold 30–60s with deep breathing.

name: Plank mit Beckenkippung (Posterior Pelvic Tilt)
notes:
Target / Focus: Core activation and pelvic stabilization.
Duration: 2 sets of 45s.
Execution: Forearm plank, actively tuck pelvis under, squeeze glutes and pull navel inward.

name: BWS-Extension (auf Faszienrolle)
notes:
Target / Focus: Thoracic extension to counter slouching.
Duration: 2 min (10–12 reps).
Execution: Foam roller under mid back, hands behind head, gently extend backward over roller.

name: Thorax-Rotation (Open Book / Buch öffnen)
notes:
Target / Focus: Thoracic spine rotation.
Duration: 10 reps per side.
Execution: Side-lying, knees at 90°. Open top arm in wide arc backward, eyes follow hand.

name: Doorway Chest Stretch (Brustöffner)
notes:
Target / Focus: Chest & shoulder opener.
Duration: 1–1.5 min per side.
Execution: Place forearm on door frame, step forward and rotate torso slightly until stretch is felt.

name: Chin Tucks & Wall Slides
notes:
Target / Focus: Deep neck flexors & lower trap activation.
Duration: 2 sets of 12 reps.
Execution: Chin tucks: create double chin against resistance. Wall slides: slide arms up wall smoothly.

name: Faszienbehandlung (Oberer Rücken)
notes:
Target / Focus: Relieve upper back tension along spine.
Duration: 3 min.
Execution: Roll out muscles along spine with peanut ball, avoid spinal bones directly.

name: Katze-Kuh & Threading the Needle
notes:
Target / Focus: Spine warm-up and mobility.
Duration: 10 reps.
Execution: Hands and knees, alternate between arching and rounding back, then thread arm through.

name: Glute Bridge mit Miniband
notes:
Target / Focus: Glute activation before heavy squats or deadlifts.
Duration: 2 sets of 15 reps.
Execution: Lie on back with miniband above knees, push knees outward, lift hips to full extension.

name: Pallof Press / Deadbugs
notes:
Target / Focus: Anti-rotation & core stability.
Duration: 2 sets of 10–12 reps.
Execution: Cable/band anti-rotation press or deadbug lowering opposite arm and leg while lower back stays flat.

name: Dynamische Hüftkreise & Beinschwünge
notes:
Target / Focus: Dynamic hip range of motion warm-up.
Duration: 10–12 reps per side.
Execution: Stand on one leg, swing free leg forward/back with control and perform wide hip circles.
